heading: Short title; “person” defined
lead: This chapter may be cited as “The Upper Mississippi River National Wildlife and Fish Refuge Act.” The term “person” as used therein includes an individual, partnership, association, or corporation.

notes.text: Codification Section is a combination provision, the first sentence being derived from section 1 and the last from section 12, of act June 7, 1924.
Amendments1998—Pub. L. 105–312 substituted “National Wildlife” for “Wild Life”.
